description: Finalizing the identification and provision of relief to Officers of the Sri Lanka Police (including the Special Task Force) and the Tri-Forces who died or became disabled as a result of terrorist acts and related activities during the period of war
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-07-14 to appoint an Officials’ Committee to submit a Report containing recommendations on the measures to be taken to finalize the identification of and provision of relief to the Officers of the Sri Lanka Police (including the Special Task Force) and the Tri-Forces who died or became disabled as a result of terrorist acts and related activities during the period of war and to issue a General Circular in place of all the circulars issued from time to time to provide such relief. The said Committee has submitted its comprehensive Report containing observations and recommendations on 2026-05-12. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to issue circular instructions to grant relief to newly identified parties in the Tri-Forces, Sri Lanka Police and the Special Task Force as per the recommendations of the said Committee, without causing prejudice to the allowances being paid to the parties identified so far, was approved by the Cabinet.
